text:
Alex T: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's P99 spike — capturing remediation steps and owners.
Maria G: thanks. summarized the main patterns in the doc (link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1777) — key noise sources were: flaky kvcache misses causing retries, and a low threshold on the request-rate alarm.
Jordan L: +1. also saw repeated identical alerts across regions because our dedupe window is too short. we get duplicate pages for the same root cause.
Priya S: can we turn this into a short action list with owners and deadlines? prefer concrete small PRs rather than vague "tune" tickets.
Alex T: absolute. proposed list below — please ack and add ETA.
Alex T: 1) Increase request-rate alarm threshold for model-serving-prod by 30% and add 2m cooldown. owner: Maria G. ETA: 3 days.
Alex T: 2) Extend cross-region dedupe window from 30s -> 180s and add fingerprinting by model+route. owner: Jordan L. ETA: 2 days.
Alex T: 3) Add a transient K/V miss metric and alert on rate of cache-priming errors (separate from token-rate alert). owner: Priya S. ETA: 1 week.
Maria G: acked. I'll open the alert PR with rationale and perf screenshots. will include a test plan that simulates 2x baseline traffic.
Jordan L: ack. for dedupe I'll update the routing-service and add a feature flag. small pseudo:```json
{
  "dedupe_window_seconds": 180,
  "fingerprint_keys": ["model", "route", "root_cause_hash"]
}
```
Priya S: ack. for the kvcache metric I'll add a heatmap to the console and a lightweight alert on 5m sustained increase. will log a playbook note for oncall steps.
PagerDuty Bot: INC-2026-1777 resolved — all nodes healthy. PagerDuty: follow-up required: assign owners for postmortem tasks.
Alex T: thanks. can we also add a recurring sweep to find alerts that fired >5 times in 24h and label them as "candidate suppression"? owner: Maria? ETA: 2 weeks.
Maria G: yep I'll add a scheduled job (weekly) and push a PR to the alerts repo.
Jordan L: one more thing — suggest adding a canary rollback policy so if bulk suppressions hide real regressions we get a slow rollout/fallback. owner: Jordan L. ETA: 2 weeks.
Priya S: putting all items into the postmortem board now and linking owners. I'll kick off calendar reminders and a 1-week sync to check progress.
Alex T: perfect. if anyone needs more cycles ping me. closing this thread once PR links are in the board. :thumbsup:
Maria G: PR opened: https://git.redwood/alerts/merge/4321 — includes threshold bump + cooldown. please review.
Jordan L: feature-flag branch created: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-180s — running unit tests.
Priya S: kvcache metric PR: https://git.redwood/observability/pull/211 — adds heatmap and alert rule.
Alex T: thanks all — leaving notes for the oncall rotation. will re-open if anything else pops up.
